info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Nosean Produce Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Nosean Produce Detail Management API facilitates the creation of detailed records for Nosean produce within the catalog system. This operation allows businesses to input and manage information about various Nosean produce items, enhancing the accuracy and accessibility of product data. Typical consumers of this API include inventory managers and e-commerce platforms that require detailed listings for online sale and distribution. By providing a streamlined process for adding produce details, this API supports better inventory control and customer engagement.

post.summary: Create new details for Nosean produce.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create and submit new details regarding Nosean produce. Ensure that all required fields are filled out correctly to successfully add the details.
